description: This file defines bindings for window management in a Lua-C integration, including functions for creating windows, controlling the draw loop, setting frame rate, saving screenshots, and global window properties.

methods.name: createWindow
methods.description: Creates a GLFW window with specified width, height, and optional rendering mode.

methods.name: noLoop
methods.description: Prevents the draw function from being called repeatedly, effectively pausing the loop.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Allows the draw function to be called repeatedly, resuming the loop.

methods.name: frameRate
methods.description: Sets the frame rate; if called without arguments, returns the current frame rate.

methods.name: saveWindow
methods.description: Saves the current window as an image file.
